an4.12:1.1: sampannasīlā bhikkhave viharatha sampannapātimokkhā pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutā viharatha ācāragocarasampannā aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvino samādāya sikkhatha sikkhāpadesu.
an4.12:1.2: sampannasīlānaṃ bhikkhave viharataṃ sampannapātimokkhānaṃ pātimokkhasaṃvarasaṃvutānaṃ viharataṃ ācāragocarasampannānaṃ aṇumattesu vajjesu bhayadassāvīnaṃ samādāya sikkhataṃ sikkhāpadesu kimassa uttarikaraṇīyaṃ
an4.12:2.1: carato cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno abhijjā … byāpādo vigato hoti thīnamiddhaṃ … uddhaccakukkuccaṃ … vicikicchā pahīnā hoti āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ caraṃpi bhikkhave bhikkhu evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitattoti vuccati.
an4.12:5.1: sayānassa cepi bhikkhave bhikkhuno jāgarassa abhijjhā … byāpādo vigato hoti thīnamiddhaṃ … uddhaccakukkuccaṃ … vicikicchā pahīnā hoti āraddhaṃ hoti viriyaṃ asallīnaṃ upaṭṭhitā sati appamuṭṭhā passaddho kāyo asāraddho samāhitaṃ cittaṃ ekaggaṃ sayānopi bhikkhave bhikkhu jāgaro evaṃbhūto ātāpī ottappī satataṃ samitaṃ āraddhaviriyo pahitattoti vuccatīti.
